context: A small library search system uses an inverted index to record which documents contain each word. An exact-word query finds documents containing the entered word, but it can miss documents that express the same idea with a synonym. A stemming step groups some inflected forms under a shared stem to reduce vocabulary variation. However, an overly aggressive stemmer can merge words with different meanings. The librarian inspects those errors rather than assuming that every merged pair is equivalent.
